spans.s: प्रेक्षक m. A spectator, a looker-on.
प्रेक्षण n. 1. View, viewing, seeing; 2. a sight, a show; 3. the eye.
प्रेक्षण-कूट m.n. the eyeball.
प्रेक्षणक n. A show, a spectacle.
प्रेक्षणिका f. A woman fond of seeing sights.
प्रेक्षणीय a. (f. या) 1. To be seen, to be gazed at; 2. to be considered as, to be regarded as; 3. beautiful to the sight, Megh.i.18, R.xiv.9.
प्रेक्षणीय a. (f. या) 1. To be seen, to be gazed at; 2. to be considered as, to be regarded as; 3. beautiful to the sight, Megh.i.18, R.xiv.9.
प्रेक्षणीयक n. A sight, a spectacle.

प्रेक्षा f. 1. Seeing, beholding; 2. sight, view, appearance; 3. a public spectacle, a sight; 4. a theatrical performance; 5. understanding, intellect; 6. deliberation, reflection; 7. the branch of a tree.
प्रेक्षा-अगार, -आगार म्।न्।, -गृह न्। m.n. 1. a council-hall; 2. a theatre.
प्रेक्षा-अगार, -आगार म्।न्।, -गृह न्। m.n. 1. a council-hall; 2. a theatre.
प्रेक्षा-गृह n. 1. a council-hall; 2. a theatre.
प्रेक्षा-वत् m. a wise man, a learned man.
प्रेक्षा-समाज m. an assembly, a crowd, an audience.
प्रेक्षित (I) a. (f. ता) Seen, viewed, looked in.
प्रेक्षित (II) n. A look, a glance.
प्रेक्षित (I) a. (f. ता) Seen, viewed, looked in.
प्रेङ्ख m.n. A swing.
प्रेङ्खा f. 1. a swing; 2. dancing; 3. a kind of building; 4. wandering, travelling; 5. a particular pace of a horse.
प्रेङ्खण (I) a. (f. णा) Going, moving, wandering, Bt.ix.106.

प्रेङ्खण (II) n. 1. Swinging; 2. a swing; 3. a minor drama consisting of one act and having no Sūtradhāra; (the S.D. thus describes it- गर्भावमर्षरहितं प्रेङ्खणं हीननायकम् । असूत्रधारमेकांकमविष्कंभप्रवेशकम् । नियुद्धसंफाटयुतं सर्ववृत्तिसमाश्रितम्).
प्रेङ्खण (I) a. (f. णा) Going, moving, wandering, Bt.ix.106.
प्रेङ्खित a. (f. ता) Shaken, oscillated, set in motion.
प्रेङ्खित a. (f. ता) Shaken, oscillated, set in motion.
प्रेङ्खोल् vt. 10U (pres. प्रेङ्खोलयति-ते) To swing, to shake.
प्रेङ्खोलन n. 1. Swinging, shaking; 2. a swing.
प्रेत (I) a. (f. ता) Dead, deceased, departed, स्वजनाश्रु किलातिसंततं दहति प्रेतमिति प्रचक्षते R.viii.86.
प्रेत (II) m. 1. The spirit before obsequial rights are performed; 2. a ghost, an evil being, Bg.xvii.4, M.xii.59.
प्रेत (I) a. (f. ता) Dead, deceased, departed, स्वजनाश्रु किलातिसंततं दहति प्रेतमिति प्रचक्षते R.viii.86.
प्रेत-अधिप m. an epithet of Yama.
प्रेत-अन्न n. food offered to the Manes.
प्रेत-अस्थि n. the bone of a dead man.
प्रेत-अस्थि˚धारिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
प्रेत-ईश, -ईश्वर m. an epithet of Yama.
प्रेत-ईश, -ईश्वर m. an epithet of Yama.
प्रेत-उद्देश m. an offering to the Manes.
प्रेत-कर्मन्, -कृत्य न्।, -कृत्या ऋ। n. funeral rites.
प्रेत-कर्मन्, -कृत्य न्।, -कृत्या ऋ। n. funeral rites.
प्रेत-कृत्या f. funeral rites.
प्रेत-गृह n. a cemetery.
प्रेत-चारिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
प्रेत-दाह m. the burning of the dead.
प्रेत-धूम m. the smoke of a funoral pile.
प्रेत-पक्ष m. an epithet of the second half of Bhādrapada when offerings made to the Manes are considered peculiarly meritorious.
प्रेत-पटह m. a drum beaten at a funeral.
प्रेत-पति m. an epithet of Yama.
प्रेत-पुर n. the city of Yama.
प्रेत-भूमि f. a cemetery.
प्रेत-मेध m. a funeral sacrifice.
प्रेत-राक्षसी f. the holy basil.
प्रेत-राज m. an epithet of Yama.
प्रेत-लोक m. the world of the dead.
प्रेत-वन n. a cemetery.
प्रेत-शरीर n. the body in which the soul departs.
प्रेत-शुद्धि f. purification after the death of a kinsman.
प्रेत-शौच n. purification after the death of a kinsman.
प्रेत-श्राद्ध n. obsequial offerings to the departed during the year of his death.
प्रेत-हार m. 1. a near kinsman; 2. one who carries out a dead body.
प्रेतिक m. A ghost, a spirit.
प्रेत्य ind. Having departed this life, in the next world, इहकीर्तिमवाप्नोति प्रेत्य चानुत्तमां गतिम् M.ii.9.
प्रेत्य-जाति f. position in the next world.
प्रेत्य-भाव m. the condition of the soul after death.
प्रेत्वन् m. 1. Wind; 2. an epithet of Indra.
प्रेप्सा f. Desire of obtaining.
प्रेप्सु a. 1. Desirous of obtaining, longing for; 2. aiming at.
प्रेमन् m.n. 1. Love, affection, kindness, Megh.i.44; 2. joy, gladness; 3. sport, pastime.
प्रेमन्-अश्रु n. a tear of affection.
प्रेमन्-ऋद्धि f. increase of affection.
प्रेमन्-पातन n. 1. tears; 2. the eye.
प्रेमन्-पात्र n. a beloved person or thing.
प्रेमन्-बंध m. the tie of love.
प्रेमन्-बंधन n. the tie of love.
प्रेमिन् a. (f. णी) Loving, affectionate.
प्रेमिन् a. (f. णी) Loving, affectionate.
प्रेयस् (I) a. (f. सी) Dearer, more agreeable, (compar. of प्रिय q.v.).
प्रेयस् (II) m. A lover, a husband.
प्रेयस् (III) m.n. Flattery.
प्रेयस् (I) a. (f. सी) Dearer, more agreeable, (compar. of प्रिय q.v.).
प्रेयसी f. A wife, a mistress.
प्रेयोपत्य m. a heron.
प्रेरक a. (f. रिका) 1. Urging, impelling, stimulating; 2. sending.
प्रेरक a. (f. रिका) 1. Urging, impelling, stimulating; 2. sending.
प्रेरण n. 1. Urging on, inciting, instigating, Na.iii.55; 2. sending, dispatching; 3. impulse, passion; 4. the sense of the causal verb (in gram.).
प्रेरणा f. 1. Urging on, inciting, instigating, Na.iii.55; 2. sending, dispatching; 3. impulse, passion; 4. the sense of the causal verb (in gram.).
प्रेरित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Impelled, instigated; 2. dispatched, sent; 3. touched.
प्रेरित (II) m. A messenger.
प्रेरित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Impelled, instigated; 2. dispatched, sent; 3. touched.
प्रेष् vt. 1P (pres. प्रेषति) To go, to move.
प्रेष m. 1. Urging on; 2. affliction, sorrow.
प्रेषण n. 1. Sending, dispatching; 2. commissioning, charging.
प्रेषणा f. 1. Sending, dispatching; 2. commissioning, charging.
प्रेषित a. (f. ता) 1. Sent, dispatched; 2. banished; 3. turned, directed; 4. ordered.
प्रेषित a. (f. ता) 1. Sent, dispatched; 2. banished; 3. turned, directed; 4. ordered.
प्रेष्ठ (I) a. (f. ष्ठा) Dearest, most beloved, (super. of प्रिय q.v.).
प्रेष्ठ (II) m. A lover, a husband.
प्रेष्ठ (I) a. (f. ष्ठा) Dearest, most beloved, (super. of प्रिय q.v.).
प्रेष्ठा f. A wife, a mistress.
प्रेष्य (I) a. (f. ष्या) To be sent or dispatched.
प्रेष्य (II) m. A servant, a menial.
प्रेष्य (III) n. Sending on a mission.
प्रेष्य (I) a. (f. ष्या) To be sent or dispatched.
प्रेष्य-जन m. servants (collectively), M.vii.125.
प्रेष्य-भाव m. servitude.
प्रेष्य-वधू f. 1. a female servant; 2. the wife of a slave.
प्रेष्य-वर्ग m. a train of servants.
प्रेहि (second person sing. of the imperative of इ with प्र q.v.)
प्रेहि-कटा f. a rite in which no mats are allowed.
प्रेहि-कर्दमा f. a rite in which no impurity is allowed.
प्रेहि-द्वितीया f. a rite at which no second person is allowed to be present.
